Distinguish confirmed POST/failed GET; check payload conflicts, owner/capability gates, persistence and interrupted/repeated navigation.

Direct read-only SQLite snapshots checked reviews, operations and mutation audit. Synthetic authentication principal; no production identity claim.

limits: Recovery envelope exists only in the mounted Session review view. Leaving/reloading loses it; no automatic replay or browser-storage persistence.
Exact reconciliation is a POST, not a read-only operation lookup. It may execute an uncommitted operation under current server gates.
A definitive rejection during replay does not settle an earlier uncertain attempt; the envelope remains pending.
No multi-tab or cross-device recovery guarantee; fresh reads and server version checks remain necessary.
Owner observations remain owner reported; checklist receipts cover bounded declarative checks only. No transcript completeness/authorship certification or external agent execution.
No private logs, shared/production database, provider calls, deployment or actual-user production authentication validation.
Only listed targeted workflows and existing checks were performed; prior owner-review report evidence remains historical.
nextTask: Review the draft PR. Consider a separately scoped read-only operation-status contract if recovery must survive leaving the view without persisting sensitive payloads in browser storage.
